description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the Ditto protocol adaptation, including methods to retrieve the provider class name and the set of blocked header keys. It also contains an enum for known configuration values with default values and configuration paths.

classes.name: ProtocolConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration methods for the Ditto protocol adaptation, including header blocklist and provider class name.

methods.name: getProviderClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the provider of the Ditto protocol adapter.

methods.name: getBlockedHeaderKeys
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of header keys that should be ignored by Ditto.
